metrics.thread_cpu_scope: time.thread_time: CPU user+system of this synchronous DjangoClient request thread only; excludes PostgreSQL/other processes and other threads, does not measure DB CPU or concurrent capacity. Direct-child CPU intervals subtracted once, independent of wall-clock subtraction; includes profiler overhead. Paired control/profiler CPU and wall observed, causal overhead not_measured; no retroactive CPU attribution to prior profiles.
metrics.overhead: Paired route without/with selected wrappers, sequential control then profile, one sample each. Difference includes instrumentation and uncontrolled PG/OS cache effects: causal overhead not_measured; no correction applied.
metrics.scope: Synchronous request only; ContextVar nested stack; subtract direct instrumented child inclusive intervals once, never grandchildren again. Added prefetch by relation, manager construction/_apply_rel_filters and Model.from_db by model; earlier profile did not have these children and exclusive times are not directly comparable. from_db includes construction/state but not prior fetch/JSON conversion. exclusive_time is relative to observed children, includes uninstrumented Python/ORM work. Inline authorization/document/revocation conditions are included in validate_submission, not separately attributed. No arguments/parameters persisted; seconds, optional p95 not_measured. SQL execute may be nested inside forms/render/context; no total-minus-SQL validation attribution. publicly_visible imported alias in discovery is not separately observed; no missing event inferred as zero.
metrics.not_measured: rows_returned/affected/scanned; CPU/RSS/waits/locks/IO; independent inline predicate timings; causal profiler overhead; concurrent capacity; p95 exclusive

gc_control.scope: gc.callbacks start/stop intervals of this process; CPU is collector thread only. Includes callback overhead and wall scheduling, not allocations or SQL/ORM rows. Events overlap enclosing rule/request intervals; never add or subtract them as an independent phase. Policy unchanged, no gc.collect/disable/threshold mutation. Causal callback overhead not_measured; no attribution to other processes or earlier runs.

gc_profiled.scope: gc.callbacks start/stop intervals of this process; CPU is collector thread only. Includes callback overhead and wall scheduling, not allocations or SQL/ORM rows. Events overlap enclosing rule/request intervals; never add or subtract them as an independent phase. Policy unchanged, no gc.collect/disable/threshold mutation. Causal callback overhead not_measured; no attribution to other processes or earlier runs.

metrics.gc_comparison_limit: Added GC callbacks to the original 10k control/RuleProfile protocol. Control response/context retained as before. Callbacks are low-volume but causal overhead not_measured; observed intervals overlap caller timings, never discounted again. CPU belongs to collector thread, not PostgreSQL/Gunicorn/load client. This synchronous profile cannot explain prior generator stalls. No collector policy or application validation changed.
metrics.binding_diagnostic_scope: Original 10k control/rule/GC protocol plus native BoundField construction, widget data extraction, model-form exclusions, construct_instance and model cleaning/metadata. No cProfile, arguments, SQL parameters or validation replacements. Child scopes are broader than prior rule profiles: parent exclusive times cannot be compared directly with those narrower reports. Direct children discounted once, not grandchildren; GC intervals overlap rules and are neither added nor discounted again. Native bound-field calls include forms rendered on the route, not only publication validation. Control response/context retained and wrappers add overhead: causal overhead not_measured; wall/thread CPU are synchronous request only, not concurrent capacity or DB CPU.
